body_en: FastQC, fastp, SeqKit, and MultiQC warnings are technical signals rather than final biological conclusions.
body_zh: FastQC、fastp、SeqKit 和 MultiQC 警告是技术信号，不是最终生物学结论。
action_en: Review library type, read length, organism, and downstream task before deciding whether to exclude data.
action_zh: 结合建库类型、读长、物种和下游任务再决定是否排除数据。

title_zh: 内嵌 QC 报告保持原生形式
body_en: The standalone report opens original MultiQC/FastQC/fastp HTML payloads as separate local pages.
body_zh: 单文件报告会把原始 MultiQC/FastQC/fastp HTML payload 作为独立本地页面打开。
action_en: Keep the full output directory for audit even though the main HTML is shareable alone.
action_zh: 即使主 HTML 可单独分享，也建议保留完整输出目录用于审计。
